Expanded `@pantoken/plugin-logos` to support the new `pantoken` product and its localized wordmark variants:

- **`scripts/generate.ts`**: added `"pantoken"` to `PRODUCTS`, added a `LANGS` list (`ar`, `el`, `fa`, `he`, `hi`, `hy`, `jp`, `ko`, `ru`, `th`, `uk`, `zh`), and `parseStem()` now detects an optional trailing `-<lang>` after the color mode, returning `{ layout, colorMode, lang? }`. The generated `name`/token id appends `-<lang>` when present.
- **`src/index.ts`**: added `"pantoken"` to `Product`, a new `LogoLang` union type, an optional `lang?: LogoLang` field on `LogoMeta`, and an optional 4th `lang` parameter on `getLogoSvg`/`getLogoDataUri`.
- Regenerated `generated/embedded.ts` and `generated/logos.css` (now 97 logos across 7 products).
- Updated tests (`scripts/generate.test.ts`, `tests/index.test.ts`) and the README to cover the new product/lang behavior.
- Added a changeset.
